'''Sensors''' are a core internal module fitted to every ship, governing detection range for other ships, signal sources, and navigational beacons. They are distinct from the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]], which is an optional internal module used for planetary and system exploration scanning rather than general contact detection.

== Overview ==

The Sensors module determines how far away a Commander can detect other contacts on the radar and target them. Higher-class Sensors extend this range, which matters for combat awareness, locating signal sources, and general situational awareness in a system.
